card.name: Dosage form words in administration text
card.fires_on: Words that name or continue a dosage form or handling step, such as suspension, injection, extended-release, pen, dose and reconstituted, in dosing and preparation instructions. Also fires on a few linking words like "the" or "fuel" in general text.

modes.label: Dosage form names
modes.description: Form words after a drug name or route, such as oral suspension, for injection, extended-release.
modes.example: The recommended starting dosage of perampanel oral<< suspension>> in adults and pediatric patients 4 years

modes.label: Preparation steps
modes.description: Parts of verbs or nouns in preparation and handling directions, such as reconstituted, drawn, single-dose.

modes.description: Scattered ordinary words in business or product-comparison text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward generic or odd nouns and away from words about manufacturing and production.
card.plain: It lights up on words that describe the form of a medicine, like oral suspension or injection, in dosing and preparation directions.
